name: Oracle predicate evaluation
scope_warning: These are GEOMETRIC and KINEMATIC results. They do not establish that the rank-1 source is satisfied. See CAD_VALIDATION_PLAN.yaml claim_fidelity.

status_vocabulary.NOT_EVALUABLE: the design does not record what the predicate needs
status_vocabulary.NOT_VERIFIED: no evidence of adequate fidelity exists

cavity.method: cavity prism minus the enclosure solid

cycle.note: geometric repeatability only; wear and cycle count are not modelled

force_window_scan.note: Matches are inspected. A line recording that a force is NOT verified is not a citation of an achieved property.

latch.architecture: integral to BODY-CLOSURE; the keeper is a rib on BODY-ENCLOSURE's front face. No separate body, no clip, no fastener, and nothing the user has to hold or put back.

blocking_probe.free_play_note: the shoulder stands 0.4 mm under the keeper, so the lid turns through 0.257 deg before the latch bites
blocking_probe.onset_method: coarse ladder, then 14 bisections between the bracketing samples
blocking_probe.release_direction: -Y, the beam deflected outward, away from the front face
blocking_probe.what_this_does_not_show: holding force, release effort, strain or fatigue
blocking_probe.what_this_shows: opening rotation is geometrically blocked while the latch is engaged and free once it is released

reengagement_probe.hold_band_meaning: below this angle the tooth is still alongside the keeper and the beam must be deflected; above it the beam is free to recover on its own
reengagement_probe.what_this_does_not_show: engagement force, snap force, strain or fatigue

latch.terminology: a latch, not a key or a lock. It provides no keying, no authorization and no security, and none is claimed.

declared_region.what: prism over the whole cavity aperture, 100 mm tall

axial_block.what_this_does_not_show: any pull-out capacity. Geometric blockage is NOT verified holding strength.
axial_block.what_this_shows: Both axial directions are blocked by realized geometry: the head shoulder one way, the recovered lug shoulders the other. The onsets are the declared axial float, not slack in the check.

deformation.representation: rigid inward translation of each arm
deformation.statement: The compressed configuration is a declared kinematic approximation of local compliant deformation. It is used to test geometric passage through the bore, not to predict continuum strain. It does not model how the material actually bends.
deformation.superseded_measurement: An earlier representation rotated each arm about its root, which differed from the relaxed solid by 4.08 mm^3 (0.38%). That representation was replaced: rotating swung the arm's far end across the axis so the envelope GREW with deflection, and it did not conserve volume. The rigid translation used now conserves it exactly, so the earlier figure no longer applies and is recorded here only so the change is traceable.

barb_geometry.measurement: greatest distance from the pin axis, doubled (circumscribed diameter)

release_access.what_this_does_not_show: ergonomic ease, finger force or comfort

topology.the_pin_is_not_a_fastener: BODY-PIN realizes the hinge axis and its own bilateral axial retention. It is a hinge element, not a latch component.
topology.what_this_shows: the latch is integral to the closure and the keeper integral to the enclosure. Nothing holds this product shut that a user could drop, lose or leave out.
